notes.title: Lover Bands: Now with Controller Support!
notes.content:
It's been a while, fans! We've heard the grumblings about the lack of controller support and we heard you! Now for the first time ever, we've enabled Nintendo Switch controller support!

Other controller support will be enabled soon, let us know in the comments which controllers you'd like to see supported.

Other improvements made in this release:
[list]
[*] A new enemy! Look out for the cannon, it shoots fireballs at you!
[*] Improved game balance in Adventure mode. Now it should be easier to learn the ropes as you start.
[*] Update slime art to be more consistent with the rest of the game.
[/list]

Happy banding!

Love, the Paper Fan Games team
